review: Being an ID that combines Poise and Bleed, Twinhook Gregor benefits a lot from being in a team that supports poise gain and inflicts a lot of bleed. His skill 3, if his passive is stacked and the second coin of this skill crits, he has enough burst damage to rival W Ryoshu's damage. However, this can only be consistent if Gregor has 2 skill slots available and he will struggle with making that damage consistent. He is a great DPS but suffers from limited support for the statuses he is using in his kit. No notable E.G.O. synergies
